limitations: No whole-model GPU compatibility fix or Mistral SYNAPSE speedup has been established.
Prototype uses real down-projection weights but synthetic activations and a small resident bank, not full inference.
GPU matches the dequantized FP32 reference; native CPU quantized expert matmul differs by about 0.0032 relative L2 in these probes.
FP32-reference agreement does not establish native-CPU or full-model logit equivalence; native-reference thresholds were not weakened.
Warm small-bank CPU data may fit cache; the separate 256 MiB CPU cache-pressure control is not a measured DRAM-bandwidth study.
Microsecond/millisecond primitive timings are not token-throughput predictions or proof of optimal hardware use.
The expanded selected-weight scratch costs 128 MiB per position, 384 MiB at three positions; cap is 512 MiB.
Sequential technical screens and strict small checks are not broad model-quality qualification.
